assistworld-assist-world:lever:97e03d3f-.title: Marketing & Administrative Assistant
assistworld-assist-world:lever:97e03d3f-.description: We are recruiting on behalf of a growing music education academy in the Bay Area that is looking for a versatile, proactive Marketing & Administrative Assistant to join its remote team. This is a hybrid role combining social media, email marketing, paid advertising support, and general administrative assistance . The academy is looking for someone who can execute consistently, take ownership of the day-to-day marketing workload, and provide reliable administrative support to the existing team. There is also an opportunity for the right candidate to contribute more strategically, particularly around brand identity and positioning , if you have the experience and creative thinking to do so. Key Responsibilities Social Media & Content Create and publish social media content using existing photos, videos, and other provided assets Repurpose existing content into engaging social posts Write captions and supporting copy Maintain a consistent posting schedule Manage and organize social media content calendars Monitor engagement and identify opportunities to improve content performance Help maintain a consistent and recognizable brand presence across platforms Email Marketing Create, schedule, and send email campaigns through Mailchimp Manage email lists and basic audience segmentation Assist with promotional and educational email campaigns Repurpose existing content into email marketing Monitor campaign performance and make recommendations for improvement Ensure email communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with the academy's brand Paid Advertising Support the management and execution of paid advertising campaigns Assist with campaign setup, creative coordination, and ongoing monitoring Track basic campaign performance and identify underperforming campaigns Help test different creative, messaging, and audience approaches Work with the team to improve lead generation and enrollment opportunities Administrative Support Answer inbound calls and provide general support Leave voicemails and follow up with prospective customers when required Assist with general remote administrative tasks Provide backup support to the existing administrative team Help ensure important tasks and communications don't fall through the cracks Support basic coordination across the business when needed Strategic Opportunity While this is primarily an execution-focused role , the client is open to someone with stronger marketing and brand experience who can bring ideas to the table. If you have experience with brand strategy, positioning, creative direction, or audience development , there may be an opportunity to help strengthen and evolve the academy's brand identity over time. We're therefore open to candidates who can do more than simply follow a content calendar—they should be able to recognize opportunities and make thoughtful recommendations. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, social media, content marketing, or a similar role Experience creating and managing social media content Experience with email marketing, particularly Mailchimp Understanding of paid social advertising and campaign management Strong written English and excellent communication skills Good eye for content, branding, and presentation Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities Comfortable working independently in a remote environment Proactive and willing to take ownership Reliable with strong attention to detail Comfortable handling administrative and customer-facing responsibilities Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a creative doer . We're looking for someone who enjoys executing campaigns, creating content, managing email and social channels, and making sure things actually get done. You should be comfortable working from existing assets and instructions, but also confident enough to say: "I think we could do this better—here's what I'd recommend." A genuine interest in music, education, creative industries, or youth developm

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:e8.title: Diesel Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:e8.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Radiance
infinityconstellation-infinity-constella.description: MEET RADIANCE The Source® of all your creative collateral. Radiance is a digital design agency powered by The SOURCE®, a proprietary Creative OS that aligns every asset, message, and moment into one adaptive brand system. We combine human-crafted design with intelligent systems to help modern brands operate with clarity, speed, and cohesion. Every engagement we deliver is not just creative output, but infrastructure: systems that scale as our clients grow. At the center is The SOURCE®, a platform blending design, AI, and automation into a single evolving system for brand truth, execution, and growth. We are backed by Infinity Constellation, the first AI holding company, and are building something category-defining at the intersection of brand, systems, and intelligence. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS Radiance is moving from services-first → platform-powered. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help architect, build, and evolve The SOURCE® from a powerful internal system into a scalable platform that supports both our agency workflows and future SaaS expansion. This is not a “ticket-taking” role. This is a role for someone who wants to shape the product, the architecture, and the technical philosophy from the ground up. You’ll work directly with the founder to translate creative workflows, brand logic, and operational complexity into elegant systems that compound over time. WHAT YOU’LL DO Platform & Product Architecture - Design and own the technical architecture of The SOURCE® - Translate creative, brand, and agency workflows into scalable systems - Build a platform that supports services today and SaaS tomorrow - Make pragmatic decisions about build vs buy vs automate Execution & Systems - Ship fast, iterate often, and prioritize leverage over perfection - Build internal tools that reduce scope creep and operational drag - Integrate AI, automation, and workflow tooling where it actually adds value - Establish technical standards, documentation, and patterns early Partnership & Leadership - Act as a thought partner to the founder on product vision and sequencing - Help define what Radiance should and should not build - Lay the groundwork for future engineering hires and contributors - Own outcomes, not just code WHAT YOU BRING - 6–12+ years experience in engineering, product, or technical architecture roles - Experience building platforms or internal systems from zero to v1 (or beyond) - Strong product intuition: you think in systems, not features - Comfort working in ambiguity with evolving requirements - Ability to translate non-technical needs into technical solutions - Pragmatic, opinionated, and execution-focused - Experience with modern web stacks, APIs, automation, and AI tooling - Bias toward leverage, simplicity, and compounding value MUST-HAVE HARD SKILLS (NON-NEGOTIABLE) 1. FULL-STACK WEB DEVELOPMENT (PRODUCTION-GRADE) - Frontend: React / Next.js (or equivalent modern framework) - Backend: Node.js / Python (FastAPI preferred) or similar - REST + basic GraphQL understanding - Authentication, permissions, role-based access - Handling real users, real data, real edge cases 2. SYSTEMS THINKING & DATA MODELING - Designing relational and/or hybrid schemas (Postgres + JSON) - Modeling entities like: - Brands - Assets - Campaigns - Messaging hierarchies - Versions / approvals / history - Understanding how systems evolve without breaking 3. WORKFLOW AUTOMATION & TOOL INTEGRATION - Integrate tools via APIs (Stripe, Jira, Webflow, CMSs, CRMs) - Use automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Temporal, etc.) - Design async workflows (approvals, handoffs, notifications) - Build internal dashboards and admin tools 4. AI / LLM PRACTICAL IMPLEMENTATION - Prompt engineering for structured outputs - Embedding LLMs into workflows - Using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Supabase, etc.) - Designing guardrails for brand voice + consistency - Knowing when NOT to use AI 5. SHIPPING MENTALITY - Scope ruthlessly - Ship v1 fast - Iterate

jobgether-jobgether:lever:61c27df1-81cf-.title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
jobgether-jobgether:lever:61c27df1-81cf-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video based in Germany. As a Senior Applied Research Engineer, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation. You will work at the intersection of generative AI research, large-scale distributed systems, and production engineering. Your work will focus on developing realistic, controllable, and expressive video generation models that can operate reliably at scale. You will own research and engineering projects end to end, translating hypotheses and experiments into measurable product impact. The role combines advanced modeling, distributed training, evaluation, inference optimization, and rigorous experimentation. You will operate in a highly technical, high-ownership environment where research is expected to move quickly toward real-world deployment. Your contributions will directly influence AI-powered video products used by businesses around the world. Develop and scale latent video diffusion models designed for human-centric video generation. Design advanced conditioning mechanisms that improve control over elements such as pose, emotion, scripts, and camera movement while maintaining high visual fidelity. Lead end-to-end applied research and engineering projects, from developing hypotheses and running experiments through to production implementation and measurable impact. Develop and optimize distributed training strategies using technologies such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, and sequence parallelism. Improve training stability and efficiency across large-scale, multi-GPU and multi-node environments while working within real-world compute constraints. Design robust evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics with structured human evaluation to assess model quality and performance. Optimize model inference for low latency, high resolution, scalability, and cost efficiency in production environments. Run controlled experiments, ablations, and parallel research hypotheses to identify high-value signals and guide modeling decisions. Establish and maintain strong engineering practices around reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and production reliability. Translate research findings into practical improvements for production-grade generative video systems. Collaborate actively with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional teams while maintaining a high degree of individual ownership. Move quickly between promising research directions, identifying low-signal approaches early and prioritizing work based on measurable outcomes. Requirements Strong professional experience training deep learning models at scale, ideally in a research or production environment. Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on expertise with PyTorch. Practical experience working with diffusion models, with image-generation experience required and video-generation experience strongly preferred. Proven experience with large-scale multi-GPU and multi-node model training. Strong understanding of distributed training frameworks and techniques such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, or comparable technologies. Ability to design controlled experiments, analyze noisy or ambiguous results, and make scientifically grounded modeling decisions. Experience with video diffusion models is an advantage. Experience with avatar generation, synthetic humans, or other human-centric generative AI applications is a plus. Familiarity with world models, interactive models, GANs, or VAEs is desirable. Experience optimizing inference systems for production deployment is an advantage. Strong understanding of CUDA and experience working within modern machine learning infrastructure. Ability to work effectively with technologies such as AWS, SLURM, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed training and inference systems. Research-driven

jobgether-jobgether:lever:68ffb0cb-ad4f-.title: Vendor Security & Standards Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:68ffb0cb-ad4f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vendor Security & Standards Manager based in Netherlands. This is a senior global security role focused on ensuring external supply chain partners consistently meet rigorous security standards. You will own vendor security requirements across carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, and last-mile providers. The role combines standards ownership, physical compliance inspections, corrective action management, and vendor performance oversight. You will operate across multiple international regions, identifying security gaps and driving measurable improvements across a complex vendor network. Success requires a firm, independent approach and the ability to hold vendors accountable while building effective working relationships. The position offers significant exposure to global supply chain security, critical infrastructure, and rapidly evolving technology environments. Extensive international travel will be an important part of the role, with occasional availability required for urgent compliance matters. Own and continuously improve the global vendor security standards framework, ensuring requirements remain comprehensive, current, enforceable, and aligned with relevant policies and industry best practices. Establish and enforce clear security compliance expectations for carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, last-mile providers, and other external supply chain partners. Ensure vendors formally accept applicable security requirements before beginning operational activities and work with legal and procurement teams to embed these obligations into contracts and service agreements. Conduct scheduled and unannounced physical inspections at vendor facilities, transit locations, and operational sites across international regions. Verify controls such as access management, personnel screening, CCTV, handling procedures, tamper-evident measures, and chain-of-custody processes against established standards, including TAPA FSR and TAPA TSR where applicable. Produce detailed inspection reports, document compliance gaps, identify systemic risks, and provide practical recommendations for remediation. Issue corrective action requirements to non-compliant vendors, establish binding remediation timelines, and track outstanding actions through to verified resolution. Conduct follow-up inspections to confirm that corrective measures have been implemented effectively and sustainably. Maintain an accurate global vendor compliance register covering inspection history, corrective actions, risk exposure, and current compliance status. Escalate persistent or serious non-compliance and recommend appropriate measures, including sanctions, suspension, or vendor replacement when necessary. Act as the primary security compliance contact for external vendors, communicating expectations clearly and assertively to security and operational leadership. Conduct structured vendor security reviews, support new-vendor assessments, and define security requirements that must be met before operational activation. Prepare global compliance reports for leadership, identify recurring patterns across vendors or regions, and recommend improvements to standards, policies, procedures, and enforcement mechanisms. Work closely with regional security teams across the USA, EU, Taiwan, APAC, Israel, and future operating regions to maintain consistent security expectations and enforcement. Requirements Significant professional experience in supply chain security compliance, vendor auditing, physical security, or security standards enforcement. Proven experience conducting physical security inspections and compliance assessments across complex, multi-vendor or international environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c5bb11fa-43ff-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager, Subscriptions based in the United States. This is a high-impact product role focused on launching and scaling a new subscription experience within a fast-growing consumer fintech platform. You’ll take ownership of the core customer journey, from signup and account setup through ongoing engagement and retention. The role offers a true zero-to-one opportunity, with responsibility spanning initial product development, launch readiness, and post-launch growth. You’ll work closely with Engineering to make thoughtful product decisions and ensure strong execution against ambitious milestones. After launch, you’ll optimize conversion, retention, customer segmentation, and acquisition strategies to build sustained traction. The position requires close collaboration across Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Customer Operations to create scalable and trusted financial experiences. This is an ideal opportunity for an autonomous product builder who thrives in fast-moving environments and enjoys balancing customer needs, commercial outcomes, and technical complexity. Own the subscription experience: Lead the development of the customer-facing journey, including signup, account setup, subscription management, and ongoing account interactions. Build engagement and retention mechanics: Design, launch, test, and continuously improve features and experiences that drive customer engagement, retention, and long-term subscription value. Drive zero-to-one product development: Take the subscription initiative from initial build through external launch and into sustained growth and market adoption. Partner closely with Engineering: Work collaboratively with engineering teams to make informed product decisions, define priorities, resolve trade-offs, and ensure high-quality execution. Lead launch readiness: Establish and manage key development, testing, operational-readiness, and launch milestones to ensure a successful external rollout. Optimize post-launch performance: Use product insights and customer behavior to improve conversion, retention, segmentation, and overall subscription performance. Support growth and go-to-market strategy: Partner with relevant teams on acquisition channels, conversion strategies, retention initiatives, and opportunities to expand the subscription offering. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Customer Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure new experiences are clear, compliant, customer-friendly, and operationally scalable. Balance competing priorities: Make pragmatic product decisions that account for customer experience, business impact, regulatory considerations, and technical complexity. Operate with ownership: Identify opportunities, proactively solve problems, and drive initiatives from concept through execution without requiring extensive oversight. Requirements Product management experience: 3–7 years of product management experience, ideally with a strong focus on consumer-facing products. Subscription expertise: Direct experience building or managing subscription products, including acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifecycle mechanics. Fintech background: Experience working with financial or fintech products at meaningful scale and an understanding of the considerations involved in consumer financial services. Startup experience: Demonstrated ability to independently ship products and make decisions in a startup or smaller-scale, high-growth environment. Strong product judgment: Ability to balance customer needs, commercial objectives, regulatory requirements, operational considerations, and technical constraints. Execution-oriented mindset: Proven ability to move quickly from strategy to execution, manage milestones, and deliver products in ambiguous or evolving environments. Cross-functional collaboration:

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:42a896fe-afd2-4fb7.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Dressly
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:42a896fe-afd2-4fb7.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Dressly — бізнес, що змінює fashion-індустрію через AI-технології та персоналізований підхід. Ми створюємо персоналізовані fashion-рішення, що допомагають людям бути собою та не боятися самовиражатися. Ми стартували у 2024 році й за останні пів року виросли x4. У 2026 році плануємо зростання x5 порівняно з 2025-м. Попит підтверджено, маємо стабільний потік користувачів. Саме тому ми шукаємо Product Marketing Manager (Middle/Senior), який/яка стане одним із ключових драйверів росту компанії. Ця роль для людини, яка любить знаходити нові можливості там, де їх ще ніхто не бачить. Ти будеш запускати нові воронки та growth-напрями з нуля, шукати точки росту в існуючих продуктах, створювати та тестувати нестандартні гіпотези, працювати на стику маркетингу, продукту та аналітики, а головне — напряму впливати на бізнес-результат. Ми не шукаємо людину для підтримки існуючих процесів. Ми шукаємо людину, яка допоможе знайти наступну точку кратного росту Dressly.
